original_card.question: Can a new local cost interface change the deficit-to-recursive-cost ratio beyond current packing?
methods: Propose a changed helper inventory and derive an optimistic exact moment.
Design a small completed instance and independently verify its endpoint and rank bill.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A new physically realizable contract outside the frozen catalogue whose per-call profile, screened with ceiling.ceiling(), beats the selected word's packing ceiling; a lower cap does not establish identical circuitry or order attainable optima, and is insufficient to pass the stronger-budget target under this model.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected word's per-call local profile, its packing ceiling and the lever table; run levers.py for the ideal budget of the lever you target.
first_step.scope: Positive control and planning budget only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Before any synthesis, write the candidate per-call local profile (and centre charge / unpaid coordinates if changed) and screen it with ceiling.ceiling(); reject it if even the ideal ceiling does not beat the selected word's by your stated margin.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Packing of the selected word is capped at +0.87% (ceiling model); only a lower local excess spend or a changed coverage law raises the cap.
allowed_variations: Narrow to one changed boundary or helper type with explicit counts.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Mixing only providers already inside the pinned catalogue.

actual_scope: Sharp abstract cost 40 for all binary scalar rectangle decoders on the 40 Eisenstein lines, with a fixed-support block-linear corollary.
scope_change_reason: We investigated ten source-basis vectors supported in orthogonal hyperplanes, which would have cost at most 30. A good-reduction rank argument excludes that candidate and proves the stronger sharp floor for arbitrary supports. This is a scoped obstruction rather than a positive native supplier.
bottleneck_link: The inherited Eisenstein screen needs cost at most 31 to beat the selected supplier. The theorem excludes that interval under its scalar pairing charge and identifies hypotheses a successor must change.
stop_rule: Finish the sharp proof, exact arithmetic replay, predecessor pins and focused PR; retain the broader constructive research goal.
evidence: Good reduction of the normalized Hermitian Gram matrix to F4; universal minor and Hadamard-rank proof; matching row-star upper bound; binary minrank-10 witness; block-linear corollary; explicit corruption controls.
author: Jose Manuel (@jmbarrancoml)
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in mathematics, implementation and prose. A read-only mathematical agent identified the good-reduction argument; the primary agent derived the trace/rank proof and implemented the replay. No independent human review.
overlap: Live refresh at 2026-10-14 17:05:32 UTC covered 381 open PRs, 646 Discussion records and 1381 local records, with complete remote pagination and no warnings. We inspected current PRs 1794 and 1977 and credited the same-field Hadamard argument from PR1590. Search coverage does not establish novelty.

open_questions.question: Can nonlinear encoding beat 40b under fixed-support per-bit pairing charges?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The proof strengthens the linear subclass but does not settle the broader nonlinear message model.
open_questions.first_step: Test an exact code on one orthogonal frame plus one non-clean message against the existing nonlinear lower bound.
open_questions.blocked_by: The Hadamard factorization requires linear message encoders.

open_questions.question: Can a native supplier share physical work below the additive pairing charge?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The theorem concerns an abstract price; a different physical contract could escape its hypotheses.
open_questions.first_step: Specify and price a small complete source, reader and frame contract with dirty-state restoration.
open_questions.blocked_by: No such native contract follows from this proof.
